raw_ocr_text:
ALL that certain lot, parcel or tract of land, situate and lying in the Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden and State of New Jersey being more particularly described as follows:

Beginning at a point in the Southwesterly right of way line of Washington Avenue (40 feet wide) where intersected by the Northerly line of Lot 12.07, said point being South 25 degrees 06 minutes 00 seconds East, 176.76 feet from the intersection of the said right of way line of Washington Avenue with the Southeasterly line of Lot 12, Block 76 and running; thence

(1) Along said Northwesterly right of way line of Washington Avenue, South 25 degrees 06 minutes 00 seconds East, 45.60 feet to a point in the division line between Lots 12.07 and 13, Block 76 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned; thence

(2) Along said division line, South 58 degrees 01 minutes 30 seconds West, 67.20 feet to a point in the Northeasterly line of Lot 12.13, Block 76; thence

(3) Along the division line of Lots 12.12 and 12.13 as shown on Plan hereinafter mentioned, North 28 degrees 36 minutes 51 seconds West, 49.46 feet to a point in the division line of Lots 12.06 and 12.07; thence

(4) Along said division line, North 61 degrees 23 minutes 09 seconds East, 69.88 feet to the point and place of beginning.

critical_assertions.note: End lot at the southeast corner of the Willits Court subdivision. Wider than interior lots (45.60 ft frontage). Abuts Lot 13 on the southeast.

common_failure_modes: OCR shows 'Northwesterly' in call (1) but should be 'Southwesterly' right of way line
Call (2) bearing S 58d01'30" W differs from the N 61d23'09" E bearing of other lot lines
notes: Lot 12.07 is the end lot at the SE corner of Willits Court, bordering Lot 13 and Washington Avenue. It is wider (45.60 ft) because it includes the remaining frontage between the last interior lot and the Lot 13 boundary. The S 58d01'30" W bearing on the Lot 13 boundary differs from the interior lot line bearings.
